category_title: Elementary students with mild mental retardation and language delay who struggle with complex reasoning and auditory triggers
scenario_title: Fine Motor and Interface Complexity in the Virtual Health Center
minimal_context: The student is using a computer mouse to click on a single OK bandage in a virtual health center.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are in Lesson 3, the health center at a school. Please use the mouse to click on the single OK bandage on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves the mouse around, unable to smoothly control the mouse to click the virtual objects) It won't go.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Clicks the wrong area and an English pop-up appears. Stares at it for a long time) Is this the lesson? I don't know these words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Still unable to smoothly control the mouse to click the single OK bandage, looking confused about her learning) I can't click the bandage. I don't know.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are in Lesson 3, the health center at a school. Please use the mouse to click on the single OK bandage on the screen.

STUDENT: (Moves the mouse around, unable to smoothly control the mouse to click the virtual objects) It won't go.

TUTOR: Keep trying to click it.

STUDENT: (Clicks the wrong area and an English pop-up appears. Stares at it for a long time) Is this the lesson? I don't know these words.

TUTOR: What do you think you should do next?

STUDENT: (Still unable to smoothly control the mouse to click the single OK bandage, looking confused about her learning) I can't click the bandage. I don't know.

task.content: In Lesson 3 'A health center at a school,' a click on a single OK bandage

context.environment: Lesson 3 'A health center at a school'
context.materials: computer mouse, interactive 3D virtual objects, single OK bandage

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Attempting to click on a small trigger area (a single OK bandage)
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: unable to smoothly control the mouse to click the virtual objects

behavior_patterns.condition: Encountering English-language system pop-up messages (e.g., 'You have no privilege to purchase this')
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: spend much time on and got stuck with it
behavior_patterns.internal_state: thinking that it was also a part of the learning material
